descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Cup Strike is an engaging physics-based shooting game built for immersive play. Aim at towers of stacked cups placed at different distances and test your precision and focus.

The new update now introduces the addition of an AK  47-style weapon, bringing a more intense and satisfying shooting experience to the game.

[media]

- Change cup designs to match your preferred style
- Instantly refresh towers to restart and try again quickly
- Turn table movement on or off for a stable or dynamic challenge
- Adjust sky colors to create the environment you like
- Switch between different scenes for a fresh experience.

[media]

This flexibility makes Cup Strike VR easy to enjoy at your own pace—whether you want a calm, relaxing session or a more engaging challenge.

Each shot delivers realistic physics—cups fall, scatter, and react based on your accuracy, making every hit satisfying and every miss a chance to improve. Instant tower reset keeps gameplay fast and uninterrupted.

With multiple environments and scenes, the game stays visually fresh. Simple mechanics, responsive controls, and smooth gameplay make it easy to start and hard to stop—perfect for both relaxation and competitive play.
